params.body:
Seventh measurement to carry verdicts.

| facet | thresholds, worst first |
| --- | --- |
| score | `SCORE_POOR` (<50, week), `SCORE_FAIR` (<90, month), `SCORE_GOOD` (ok) |
| lcp / inp / cls | `*_POOR` (week), `*_FAIR` (month, new middle entries), `*_GOOD` (ok), on Google's numbers already in the registry |
| weight | `PAGE_HEAVY` (>3000 kB, month), `PAGE_LIGHT` (ok) |
| savings | `SAVINGS_LARGE` (>=1000 ms, month), `SAVINGS_SMALL` (ok) |

The 50, 90, 3000 and 1000 are Portal's card numbers, copied. The reading is written flat (`lcpMs`, `inpMs`, `cls`, `pageWeightKb`, `biggestSavingMs`) next to the `field`/`lab` maps so the registry can read it; INP exists only in the field. Each opportunity carries `large: true` when it saves a second or more, so the card's rows map a word instead of comparing a number.

Tests: three cases in `VitalsScanTest`. Suite 611 green, PHPStan and Pint clean. Branched from main after #177.
params.title: Vitals judges its own facts: score, the three vitals, weight and the biggest saving
